Done! I've created `src/routes/posts.js` with a `postPath(title)` function that:
- Returns `/posts/` followed by a URL-safe slug of the title
- Uses the app's existing `slugify` utility (same as `users.js` does)
- Matches the naming and export convention of the rest of the codebase

The function converts titles like "Hello & Goodbye" to paths like `/posts/hello-and-goodbye`.
